newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares static, little activity foreseen.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares static, little activity foreseen.

text.p: Danish share prices showed little movement in Friday's opening trade and dealers expected sparse business in a session sandwiched between Thursday's Ascension Day holiday and the weekend.
"All the indications are for a very quiet day," a dealer said.
At O740 GMT the KFX top-20 index was virtually unchanged, at 159.75 compared to Wednesday's closing 159.74 and its June future was untraded at 159.70.
One of the few top-20 shares moving was SAS, which was up 1.90 crowns to 68.00.
The carrier's share plunged 3.90 crowns on Wednesday, after it surprised the market with first-quarter losses.
